description: Caribbean Netherlands, Saba; ferry passengers, 2014-3rd quarter 2025 is a dataset listed in Dutch national open data portal, an open data portal, published or maintained by CBS OpenData. This table contains the number of passengers (excluding crew members) arriving by ferry on Saba from Sint Maarten and Sint Eustatius. The figures published here are entirely based on available registers, i.e. Coverage: the Netherlands. The portal files it under the publisher CBS OpenData. It offers 2 resource(s) in HTTP://PUBLICATIONS.EUROPA.EU/RESOURCE/AUTHORITY/FILE-TYPE/ATOM, HTTP://PUBLICATIONS.EUROPA.EU/RESOURCE/AUTHORITY/FILE-TYPE/JSON. The portal shows 2026-04-15 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support port and shipping studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ckan-nl-portal.
